questions.title: Largest Rangeland (Grassland) Area
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest total area of rangeland (native grassland, shrubland, and open range).
questions.disclaimer: Non-federal plus federal rangeland acres as classified by NRCS. Rangeland is distinct from cropland and pastureland. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service — Natural Resources Inventory

questions.title: Largest Coniferous Forest Area
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest area of coniferous (softwood) forest.
questions.disclaimer: Timberland and other forestland classified by FIA as softwood forest-type groups (pine, fir, spruce, hemlock, cedar, redwood). Alaska's boreal forests are included. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA Forest Service — Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA)

questions.title: Largest Island Area Under State Jurisdiction
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest total land area of islands (river, lake, coastal, and offshore) under their jurisdiction.
questions.disclaimer: Total land area of all islands lying within a state's legal boundaries, including inhabited and uninhabited islands in oceans, gulfs, sounds, lakes, and rivers. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset — Island features

questions.title: Most Named Barrier Islands
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most named barrier islands along their coasts.
questions.disclaimer: Named barrier islands as inventoried by USGS coastal geology surveys. Excludes barrier spits still attached to the mainland. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USGS Coastal and Marine Geology Program — Barrier Island inventory

questions.title: Most Named Canyons
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most named canyons catalogued in the USGS Geographic Names Information System.
questions.disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features whose names include 'Canyon' by state. Reflects naming convention as much as underlying topography. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) — feature class 'Valley' filtered to canyon names

questions.title: Longest River Wholly Within Borders
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the longest single river that flows entirely within their own borders.
questions.disclaimer: Longest single named river whose entire course lies within one state's boundaries. Rivers that cross state lines are excluded. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset — river length by state

questions.title: Most Named Plateaus
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most named plateaus catalogued in the USGS Geographic Names Information System.
questions.disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features whose names include 'Plateau' or 'Mesa' by state. Reflects Southwestern mesa-country naming density. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) — feature class 'Flat' filtered to plateau/mesa names

questions.title: Most Named Bays
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most named bays catalogued in the USGS Geographic Names Information System.
questions.disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features classified as 'Bay' by state, including tidal, lake, and river bays. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) — feature class 'Bay'

questions.title: Most Named Sounds
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most named sounds (elongated coastal or inland water bodies) catalogued in the USGS GNIS.
questions.disclaimer: Counts of GNIS features whose names include 'Sound' by state, covering marine straits between islands and mainland as well as broad estuarine passages. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) — feature class 'Channel/Sound'

questions.title: Largest Peak Snowpack (SWE)
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest peak-season snowpack, measured as snow water equivalent (SWE) averaged across NRCS SNOTEL sites.
questions.disclaimer: Average April 1 snow water equivalent across all SNOTEL sites in each state. April 1 is the traditional peak for the Western U.S. snowpack cycle. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service — SNOTEL network

questions.title: Most Craft Distilleries
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most licensed craft distilleries.
questions.disclaimer: Count of DSP-licensed craft distilleries operating in each state (ACSA definition). Includes Washington DC.

source.name: American Craft Spirits Association — Annual Economic Impact Report

questions.title: Most Wineries
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most bonded wineries.
questions.disclaimer: Bonded winery count includes all TTB-permitted winery premises, from major producers to boutique operations. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Most Farmers Markets
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most farmers markets registered with the USDA.
questions.disclaimer: Total count of currently listed farmers markets in the USDA Local Food Portal directory. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USDA AMS — National Farmers Market Directory

questions.title: Highest EV Share of New Vehicle Sales
questions.prompt: Name the US states where electric vehicles make up the highest share of new light-duty vehicle registrations.
questions.disclaimer: Battery-electric vehicles as share of new light-duty registrations; hybrids and plug-in hybrids excluded. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: Alliance for Automotive Innovation — Get Connected EV Report

questions.title: Most Utility-Scale Solar Capacity Installed
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most installed utility-scale solar electricity generating capacity.
questions.disclaimer: Cumulative installed utility-scale + distributed PV capacity in gigawatts (AC-DC mixed by SEIA convention).

source.name: SEIA / Wood Mackenzie — US Solar Market Insight

questions.title: Most Wind Capacity Installed
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most installed wind electricity generating capacity.
questions.disclaimer: Cumulative installed onshore + offshore wind nameplate capacity in gigawatts. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — Electricity Data Browser
